enabled.Name: Enable Nameplate Auto-Fit
enabled.Hint: Automatically shrink, wrap, or truncate token nameplates so they never exceed the width of their token.

minFontSize.Name: Minimum Font Size
minFontSize.Hint: The smallest font size nameplates may shrink to before wrapping or truncating instead.

fontShrinkStep.Name: Font Shrink Step
fontShrinkStep.Hint: How many pixels to reduce the nameplate font size by on each shrink attempt.

colorByDisposition.Name: Color Nameplate by Disposition
colorByDisposition.Hint: Color nameplate text using the token's disposition color (hostile, neutral, friendly, or secret).

maxLines.Name: Maximum Nameplate Lines
maxLines.Hint: The maximum number of lines a wrapped nameplate may span before the last line is truncated with an ellipsis.

replaceElevationIcon.Name: Replace Elevation Icon
replaceElevationIcon.Hint: Replace the "+" in a token's elevation tooltip with the world's configured Flying status effect icon. Does nothing if no Flying status effect is configured.

DisableAutoFit.Name: Disable Nameplate Auto-Fit
DisableAutoFit.Hint: Prevent this token's nameplate from being automatically shrunk, wrapped, or truncated to fit its width.
